title: Guidelines and Standards for Installation and Operation of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure - 2024
issuing_authority: Ministry of Power, Government of India

urban_density.standard: In urban areas, the target shall be to provide at least one charging station within a 1 km x 1 km grid by FY 2029-30 (FY 2030)
urban_density.applicability: Urban Agglomerations / Municipal Areas (e.g. Pune Urban Area: PMC + PCMC)

highway_spacing.standard: On highways and expressways, charging stations should be installed at a distance of every 20 km on both sides
highway_spacing.applicability: National Highways, Expressways, State Highways (e.g. Samruddhi Mahamarg)

heavy_duty_long_range.standard: For long range and/or heavy duty EVs, there shall be at least one fast-charging station every 100 km on each side of highways and expressways
heavy_duty_long_range.technical_specification: At least two EV chargers of minimum 240 kW capacity each with CCS-2 connector gun or higher standard

open_access_power.standard: Connectivity and electricity connection to public charging station within 7 days in metro cities, 15 days in municipal areas, 30 days in rural areas

tariff_structure.standard: Single part tariff not exceeding Average Cost of Supply (ACoS) during solar hours and up to 1.2 times ACoS during non-solar hours
